output.content:
Glucose differences between CHO-004-R01 and CHO-004-R02 (Northfield Biologics · October runs), defined as CHO-004-R02 minus CHO-004-R01 at exactly matched elapsed sample times:

- **Mean signed difference: −0.239 g/L** over 11 matched sample times (0.0 to 142.0 h); negative means CHO-004-R02 ran lower than CHO-004-R01 on average.
- **Largest absolute difference: 0.944 g/L**, occurring at **19.5 h elapsed**, where CHO-004-R01 was 7.133 g/L and CHO-004-R02 was 6.189 g/L.

CHO-004-R01 also has a 164.0 h sample with no counterpart in CHO-004-R02; it is excluded. The mean is derived from the returned per-time differences, not measured directly.

All values come from the **Northfield Biologics · October runs** delivery, which is still in review: its data was read from the delivery files but not yet reviewed, so every number above is provisional and unverified. The other deliveries still in review are **Northfield Biologics · November runs** and **Harborview CDMO · fed-batch runs**, also provisional; none of these values should be relied on until the deliveries are verified.
